card.name: Inside brand drug names in capitals
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of capitalized brand drug names, such as the AY in VRAYLAR or ULT in REXULTI, when the name is split into parts. It also fires on a capitalized surname split the same way.

modes.label: Brand name middle
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps brand drug name in label text, before the name ends.

modes.label: Capitalized person name
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps personal name in an author bio.
modes.example: PAULA POL<<K>> LILLARD is the head emer

card.plain: It marks the middle of an unusual capitalized brand name that is written in pieces.
